show.description: Meera is a beautiful young woman who has done a lot for her boyfriend, Kiran. One day, she decides to reveal her true identity. At that moment, a series of unexpected events unfold. Did Meera finally marry Kiran? Watch 'The Mysterious CEO', only on Kuku TV.
